conformance.rationale: The Conversion-owned exact corpus is replayed byte-for-byte through C++ and the public C ABI; native transport and lifecycle invariants are tested here.

retained_responsibilities: App retains existing execution tests until verified Computation cutover, then only composition, authorization, storage, provisioning/recovery, acceptance and end-to-end performance tests.
The later kumwe/kumwe-engine binding owns PHP/Zend marshalling, lifecycle, module-load and cross-layer corpus tests.
